prs.author: ddullah
prs.reason: [llm] cluster primary: BrokenResourceError propagates out of stdout_reader when stdio_client's context exits while the subprocess is still writing output, causing an unhandled exception instead of a clean shutdown. (2 PRs)

This manifests as lost pre-entry cancellations and spurious CancelledError propagation during __exit__ when the request is already completed. (2 PRs)
prs.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: RequestResponder.__enter__ was replacing the cancel scope created in __init__ with a fresh uncancelled scope, causing any cancel() call made before __enter__ to target a discarded scope.
